Allowed origins (per `worker/src/index.ts`, `app.use('*', cors({...}))`, lines ~20-33):

- `http://localhost:4200` (exact match)
- any `*.pages.dev` subdomain (`origin.endsWith('.pages.dev')`)
- any `*.workers.dev` subdomain (`origin.endsWith('.workers.dev')`)

Everything else returns `null` (rejected) via the `origin` callback.

**To add a new custom domain:** edit the `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts` (inside `cors({...})`), adding a check like `origin === 'https://yourdomain.com'` (or an `.endsWith()` check for a wildcard) to the existing `if` condition before returning `origin`. Array-based config won't work here since Hono only matches array entries as exact strings. See `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md §4 (CORS)` for more detail.
